purpose: Fuse the deployable image-view scores (E149 pixel views) with the current compliant optimum E233 mean_align (e226_auc2W representation + symmetric batch-mean alignment). Every image view goes through the same E228/E233 scoring flow (task-wise standardisation on the fit rows -> PCA96 -> k=12 prototypes per (task, identity) -> negative nearest distance) and the same E233 symmetric per-(session, task) batch-mean alignment. Fusion weights are written here BEFORE the run and are never tuned on Test. Objective: raise the Test S2-vs-S1 separation AUC above 0.8795 and the S2 acceptance at an S1>=0.95 gate above 0.706.

predecessors.eeg_score: E233 mean_align (research/E233_delta_estimation/cache/test_v1_mean_align.npz), i.e. E228 e226_auc2W + symmetric batch-mean alignment; frozen, not refitted.
predecessors.image_views: research/E149_image_route_audit (pixel space, 32x32x3 = 3072) and research/E143_k_sweep_nearest/run_e143.py for the scoring harness.
predecessors.purity: E233 / E232 label-free test-session2 k-means purity (k=20).

image_route_audit_e149.note: test AUC = S2-vs-S1 AUC of the unaligned image score with the E149 harness (all-train-row standardisation and prototypes).

protocol.task_standardisation: per-task mean/std of the fit rows (trial fraction <= 0.6, all 20 identities) applied to Train and Test (E228 rule).
protocol.prototype_init: random sample init, seed = 17 * identity, 20 Lloyd iterations (E143 harness).
protocol.known_reference: inner 5-block out-of-fold scores of the fit rows (prototypes built on the other 4 blocks); this is the Train-side ECDF reference for the rank transform. Folds are blocks of floor(5 * trial_fraction) clipped to [0,4].
protocol.loso: 20 folds, one held-out identity each; prototypes from the enrolled identities' fit rows; unknown = held-out identity rows with trial fraction in (0.6, 0.8], known = enrolled rows in the same window (E227/E233 protocol, verified to reproduce the frozen fold caches row-for-row).
protocol.alignment: E233 mean_align applied in each component's own PCA space: z <- z - mean(z | session, task) + mu_ref(task); mu_ref(task) is the fit-row mean of the task, which is exactly 0 because the PCA basis is centred on the fit rows. One identical rule for both sessions, min_cell_n = 200. Session is only a batch key: it never selects an identity and never gates a sample. LOSO rows are not aligned (they are single-session Train data).

eeg_component.purpose: alignment-applied EEG score = the E233 mean_align Test score (frozen). Ref = deploy inner-OOF known scores. LOSO = frozen per-fold scores, unaligned, identical to E233.

image_views.spec: the 7 pixel-space views are scored separately; IMG_px_all is their equal-weight mean in z-score space (the E149 definition), not a feature concatenation.

fusion.rank_transform: per-task empirical CDF of the fit-row OOF known reference scores: r = P(ref_task <= s); higher = more likely known.
fusion.note: fuse_zscore_50_50 standardises each component with the mean/std of its fit-row OOF reference scores and averages; it is the scale-control candidate. fuse_rank_50_50 with X_mw_cov4 and X_covariance_hr are reported as single-view fusion diagnostics.

round2_candidates.when: only reported as the allowed single follow-up round; never used to re-pick the verdict of round 1

fuse_rank_50_50_threeview.image_component: mean of X_mw_cov4, X_covariance_hr, IMG_px_all ranks

metrics.separation_auc: S2-vs-S1 AUC of the fused Test score (ties handled by mid-rank).
metrics.loso_gate: tau = 10th percentile of the pooled LOSO unknown fused scores, i.e. LOSO unknown rejection = 0.90 (the compliant operating point); read Test S1 rejection and S2 acceptance there.
metrics.s1_gate_095: tau = 95th percentile of the fused Test S1 scores; read S2 acceptance (official gate).
metrics.fold_s2_proxy: per-fold acceptance of the enrolled (known) rows with trial fraction in (0.6,0.8] at the LOSO=0.90 tau; mean +- std over the 20 folds.

purity.space: frozen E233 baseline EEG PCA space (no alignment), k-means k=20, seed 20261117+20, 60 Lloyd iterations on all 19218 Test session2 rows; the partition is identical for every candidate
purity.reported: purity over the accepted S2 rows at the candidate's tau, using the EEG-branch predicted identity (the fused score is scalar, it carries no identity head)
purity.baseline_definition: the same quantity for the EEG-only candidate at its own LOSO=0.90 tau

metrics.coverage: number of distinct identities among the accepted Test rows

decision_rule.valid: S2 at the S1>=0.95 gate > 0.706 AND separation AUC > 0.8795 AND accepted-row purity >= 0.95 x baseline purity
decision_rule.separable_only: separation AUC rises but S2 at the S1>=0.95 gate does not -> report 'the separability gain did not translate into the operating point' and explain why
decision_rule.fail: every candidate is worse than the baseline -> state that fusing image views with the aligned EEG score gives no gain, with the evidence

limitations: Only 7 image types have both Train and Test caches; GAF / MTF / spectrogram / DINOv3 exist only for Train and cannot be used.
Test has no identity labels: official C / RA / ASafeR are N/A; S1 rejection and S2 acceptance are the only read-outs.
Test has been inspected repeatedly since E65, so every S2 number carries a repeated-inspection bias; four fusion weights and all thresholds are fixed in this file before the run.
E232 showed session and registration status are confounded (S1 = 5 unregistered subjects, S2 = 20 enrolled users); alignment uses session only as a batch key.
The mean alignment is batch/transductive: it estimates an unlabelled statistic on the batch that is being scored, which needs confirmation against the competition rules.
The fused score is scalar; identity still comes from the EEG branch, so purity/coverage only measure whether the fused accept decision keeps coherent identities.
